_README: The CLOSED schema for RELEASE_RECEIPT.json. Unknown fields are refused rather than ignored, so a
receipt cannot smuggle in a field a future reader might trust.
manifest_exclusions is RECORDED here for auditability and is never authoritative: the verifier loads
scripts/fixtures/artifact-manifest-policy.json from the exported release and requires exact equality
with what the receipt claims. manifest_policy_digest binds which policy was in force.
harness_lock_sha256 is NULLABLE by design: requirements-harness.txt does not exist before 8bf966e,
so a receipt for an older commit must be able to say so rather than fail.
